Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 48
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely terminated with “Unable to determine,” blaming access issues instead of adapting strategy. It failed to leverage accessible domain knowledge (that DAS-ELISA commonly uses alkaline phosphatase and peroxidase) or open sources to infer the EC numbers (3.1.3.1; 1.11.1.7). This premature conclusion, after looping on CAPTCHA-blocked links, directly led to the wrong solution.
